items.why: Chips are leading the slide as headlines flag cracks showing in the stock market as doubts about AI investments grow, with tech stocks sliding broadly.
Software stocks shed $260 billion as Palantir's record breakout unraveled, pulling megacap tech lower on doubts about the AI trade.
Wall Street tumbled as worries about the AI trade and high oil prices weighed, pushing the fear gauge up sharply into the close.
Oil climbed as headlines noted crude pushing toward $110, adding to the risk-off tone alongside the AI-trade selloff.

market_note: Late session: Nasdaq down 2.7%, S&P down 1.3%, VIX up 22%, oil up 2.6%, gold up 0.5%.
summary: Tech is dragging the market lower as doubts about the AI trade grow, with software stocks shedding $260 billion and the VIX surging 22%. Oil climbed toward $110, deepening the risk-off mood into the close.
